1.0.1.en: Fixed: power-on behavior, indicator LED, child lock and backlight settings were not being read or applied on Tuya smart plugs and switches. Added: a 'Reset energy meter' button on smart plugs to zero the energy total shown by Homey.

1.0.3.en: Improved: device availability detection is more reliable — fixed devices being wrongly marked offline, and a misleading 'available' trigger firing after an app restart. Rejected settings writes are now logged to help diagnose issues.

1.0.5.en: Added: an availability on/off switch in the app settings page. Improved: availability detection is simpler and lighter - a device is marked unavailable after 25 minutes of silence or 5 failed commands in a row, and comes back as soon as it talks. Fewer Zigbee messages: on/off reporting every 30 minutes and spaced-out smart plug reporting. Traffic statistics are now kept in memory and start over when the app restarts. Removed: the 'Became available' and 'Became unavailable' flow cards.
